Lush may also have teased it on Instagram a day or so before Bustle. The search term is ambiguous (there is also a Lush shower gel of the same name).

cases.announce_quote: Lancôme has announced the return of Juicy Tubes.
cases.outcome_quote: The product was briefly discontinued in 2018 and made a comeback in 2020. ... "This is our signature gloss."
cases.outcome_note: Lancôme kept Juicy Tubes in its core range after the 2020 return and in May 2025 was still running campaigns and adding shades.
cases.confidence_reason: Announcement date is solid (Nylon 2020-04-30, GMA 2020-05-01). The outcome evidence is from 2025, not from the 24-month mark (2022-04), but continuous sale through 2025 implies it was sold in 2022. Note: the 2020 run included 10 limited-edition shades alongside 10 core shades.
